metadata.description: Account management skills for B2B service companies: client health scoring, upsell mapping, case study production.

plugins.name: account-management-engine
plugins.description: 3 Claude Code skills that execute the retention & growth block of a GTM system for B2B service companies: client health check (6-criteria green/yellow/red scoring with action plans), upsell mapper (client × services cross-sell matrix with prioritized entry moves), and case study writer (project → publishable case in 3 formats). Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
